#: Base language. Every key in use must have a text here: other languages fall back to it.
#keys: A key is a latin label, never a sentence. Substitution is by name: %(name)s.
#adding: A new section goes into a NEW FILE in this folder - no existing file is rewritten.
#section: The journal: a level it does not know, a sink that dropped out, a stream that is not there. The level names (debug, info, warn, error) are settings the code reads, not texts, and stay as they are in every language.
journal.noStream: there is no stream to write to
